scripts.dev: bun run dev:check && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env AGENT_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000 bun run --cwd web dev
scripts.frontend: cross-env AGENT_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000 bun run --cwd web dev
scripts.setup: bun run setup:frontend && bun run setup:backend && bun run setup:done
scripts.setup:backend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "cd server; if(-not(Test-Path venv)){python -m venv venv}; venv\Scripts\pip install -q -r requirements.txt"
scripts.setup:done: node -e "console.log('\n Setup complete! Run: bun run dev')"
scripts.doctor: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let ok=true; if(!fs.existsSync('node_modules')){console.error('- root node_modules missing; run bun install');ok=false;}else{console.log('- workspace dependencies installed');} if(!ok)process.exit(1);"
scripts.doctor:local: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let ok=true; ['AGORA_APP_ID','AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE'].forEach(k=>{const env=fs.existsSync('server/.env.local')?fs.readFileSync('server/.env.local','utf8'):''; if(!new RegExp('^'+k+'=.+','m').test(env)){console.error('- '+k+' missing in server/.env.local');ok=false;}else console.log('- '+k+' configured');}); if(!ok)process.exit(1);"
scripts.verify:local: bun run doctor:local && bun run verify:backend && bun run verify:local:fastapi && bun run verify:web:proxy && bun run verify:web:build
scripts.verify:backend: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "cd server; venv\Scripts\python -m py_compile src/server.py src/agent.py; echo 'server.py and agent.py OK'"
scripts.verify:web: bun run doctor && bun run verify:web:api && bun run verify:web:build
scripts.clean: bun run clean:backend && bun run clean:frontend
